column3: With respect to the Ellenton Premium Outlets Mortgage Loan (3.1%), Saks Global Enterprises LLC and 112 affiliated debtors filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on January 13 and 14, 2026 in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of Texas, Houston Division. Pursuant to an interim order entered by the Bankruptcy Court on February 2, 2026, the Saks debtors have been authorized to conduct closing sales at certain Saks OFF 5TH store locations, including the Ellenton Premium Outlets Mortgaged Property location, and such locations are anticipated to close as part of the reorganization.
